visualBrief.primarySubject: the specific policy, governance, market, or industry action described by the story
visualBrief.scene: A sophisticated editorial photo-illustration or carefully staged metaphor that makes the specific central idea immediately understandable without relying on generic AI symbols.
supportingElements: at most one concrete metaphorical object or environmental cue tied directly to the story
visualBrief.composition: One strong metaphor or visual action, restrained editorial treatment, clear hierarchy, no collage of unrelated symbols.
avoid: glowing holograms, floating code, HUDs and neon sci-fi effects
prominent readable text or fake headlines
